description: This Java class 'ImmutableJsonArrayBuilder' provides a builder pattern implementation for creating immutable JSON array instances, supporting various data types and fluent API methods.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonArrayBuilder
classes.description: A final class implementing JsonArrayBuilder, providing methods to construct an immutable JSON array with various data types.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ImmutableJsonArrayBuilder.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds various data types (int, long, double, boolean, String, JsonValue) to the builder.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a value at a specific index in the array being built.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves an element at a specified index, wrapped in Optional.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an element at a specified index or a specific JsonValue.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns an ImmutableJsonArray containing the added values.
